response.original_title: [ADD-Passenger] Can I Add a Passenger to My Silversea Cruise After Booking?
response.overview: To add a passenger to your Silversea cruise 1-866-254-7549, you must call Silversea Customer Service at 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44 (120) 420-8151 (UK), or contact your original travel advisor. You cannot add a passenger online or through the mobile app.Requirements and What to Prepare Booking Reference: Have your current reservation number ready 1-866-254-7549. New Passenger Details: Provide the full legal name, date of birth, and payment information for the new guest 1-866-254-7549. Suite and Ship Capacity: Adding a guest depends on whether your specific suite has maximum occupancy space (such as a third or fourth berth) and total ship lifeboat limits 1-866-254-7549. Pricing Updates: The booking will be re-priced at current market rates, and you may owe additional fare, taxes, or fees 1-866-254-7549. Timing: Changes must be requested well before the final passenger manifest submission deadline, and at least one original guest must remain on the booking 1-866-254-7549.
